front.title: RFC 4181 Update to Recognize the IETF Trust

abstract.t: This document updates RFC 4181, "Guidelines for Authors and Reviewers of MIB Documents", to recognize the creation of the IETF Trust.

section.name: Status of This Memo
section.t: This document specifies an Internet Best Current Practices for the Internet Community, and requests discussion and suggestions for improvements. Distribution of this memo is unlimited.

section.name: Introduction
section.t: In order to reflect the creation of the IETF Trust, certain updates to the copyright notices required in IETF documents by RFC 3978 have been published in RFC 4748 . This document updates RFC 4181 to bring it into alignment with those changes.

section.name: Updates to RFC 4181
section.t: The text of RFC 4181 is hereby updated as set forth below to reflect the creation of the IETF Trust.

section.name: Updates to Section 3.7
section.t: In the copyright notice templates in Section 3.7, replace all occurrences of "The Internet Society" with "The IETF Trust".

section.name: Security Considerations
section.t: The updates in this document have no impact on the security of the Internet.
